description: Edit one owned contact. Omit to keep; lists replace. Read before adding. request_id retries safely; change_id supports undo. ($0.10; API key required)

address.description: Postal address (one line). Null or blank clears

birthday.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, or MM-DD / --MM-DD (year unknown; 02-29 ok). Null/empty clears

cadence_days.description: Check-in every N days; null or 0 turns check-ins off. Next check-in is recomputed

company.description: company. Omit to leave unchanged; null or blank clears.

contact_origin.description: Personal relationship, found online, or imported.

death_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; marks the contact deceased. Null clears

discovery_source.description: Where found, e.g. Facebook suggestions. Null clears.

education.description: Merge school entries by id. New entry needs school only; omit unknown qualifications/dates.

items.description: Entry fields; null clears optional values.

end_date.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, if known.

id.description: Saved id to patch; omit for a new entry.

start_date.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, if known.

email.description: email. Omit to leave unchanged; null or blank clears.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional ISO updated_at you last read. Write applies only if unchanged; otherwise code "conflict" with the current record and changes nothing.

first_met.description: When/how they first met (free text). Null or blank clears

first_met_location.description: Where they first met. Null or blank clears

hobbies.description: Replace list; [] clears; omit to keep. Read before adding.

interests.description: Replace list; [] clears; omit to keep. Read before adding.

is_deceased.description: false also clears death_date and the memorial reminder

last_interaction_at.description: Owner correction: YYYY-MM-DD or zoned ISO time; not future.

locations.description: Merge by id; omitted entries/fields stay. City or approximate area suffices. Never infer a residence.

items.description: Entry fields; null clears optional values.

id.description: Saved id to patch; omit for a new entry.

kind.description: Purpose if known; primary alone does not imply residence.

name.description: Rename and refresh slug; use for spelling fixes.

notes.description: Replaces people.notes (does not append). Empty or null clears

occupation.description: Occupation / job title. Omit to leave unchanged; null or blank clears.

phone.description: phone. Omit to leave unchanged; null or blank clears.

preserve_old_name_as_alias.description: Keep old name as former_name alias; default true.

pronouns.description: e.g. she/her. Null or blank clears

relationship.description: Relationship label (friend, sister, …). Empty or null clears

remove_education_ids.description: Explicitly remove only these school entry ids; legacy summary stays.

remove_location_ids.description: Explicitly remove only these location ids.

wallets.description: ENS/SNS names or addresses. [] clears wallets; other social handles stay.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

change_id.description: Pass to undo_contact_change to revert this change, birthday and birthday_precision included.

changed.description: Changed fields with before and after values.

former_name_alias.description: After a rename that keeps the old name (preserve_old_name_as_alias, default true): alias, saved, and reason when it could not be kept.

hint.description: Where the not_applied fields are changed instead (the Dayze profile).

is_self.description: True when the person is the user's own card (Me).

items.description: On Me, a profile-mirrored field (name, birthday) that was not saved.

person.description: A Dayze person or contact record.

provenance.description: Which connector wrote the record and which connected Dayze account received it.
